name: Automotive Equipment of Nevada
old_description: AEN has been serving the automotive industry for over 34 years. We are a full-service automotive shop equipment distributor, selling and servicing the top-tier automotive shop equipment brands.
about:
Automotive Equipment of Nevada (AEN) operates from Las Vegas, Nevada. The company was founded in 2006, though it reports more than 34 years of experience serving the automotive aftermarket. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

AEN functions as a full-service distributor of automotive shop equipment, representing top-tier manufacturers. Its offerings span individual items such as jacks and alignment systems up to complete frame-pulling bays. Beyond sales, the firm provides design services for ground-up dealership construction and major remodels, coordinating with general contractors early to prevent costly change orders. A service division with over 20 years of repair experience handles everything from stuck lifts to leaking oil lines, while an installation team fits equipment ranging from single oil reels to dealerships with more than 80 in-ground lifts.

The primary customers are automotive dealerships, independent repair shops, and general contractors involved in facility projects. AEN’s work includes outfitting new dealership builds and supporting remodels for existing service centers.

The company emphasizes a single-source model: because it installs what it sells, it asserts that all components work together harmoniously. Nevada contractor licenses 86133 and 86134 underscore its compliance with state regulations for construction-related installations.
